note: First mapping of record kinds, link relations and exported attributes to RDF. An external term is used only where its meaning matches; everything else is in the rewire vocabulary. Changes to this file are reviewed like record changes.

method.basis: A described procedure, independent of a trained artifact (W3C ML Schema Algorithm).

model.basis: A named model or model family as released. Most model records are families, which are neither executable implementations (mls:Implementation) nor trained artifacts (mls:Model), so no external class is asserted.

configuration.basis: The exact setup that produced scores. Many are reported labels, paper comparators or score-threshold schemes rather than trained artifacts, so mls:Model is not asserted.

pipeline.basis: A multi-stage system; its results are not results of any model it uses.

service.basis: A hosted service with its own terms and limits.

benchmark.basis: No external class matches a benchmark suite as used here.

task.basis: Linking to EDAM Operation needs a reviewed per-task mapping; not yet done.

protocol.basis: OBI protocol: a plan specification of how to carry out a process.

evaluator.basis: Scoring software such as AMBER, OPAL or PoseBusters; not an implementation of a machine-learning algorithm.

dataset_subset.basis: A defined subset is itself a dataset.

baseline.basis: A proposed or source-supported comparison procedure; no external class matches.

evaluation.basis: One execution of a configuration under a protocol, as reported.

result.basis: ML Schema ModelEvaluation holds one measured value of an evaluation measure.

source.basis: Paper, supplement, repository file or web page. A finer schema.org type needs a reviewed per-source field.

claim.basis: One sourced assertion about another record; its sources via dcterms:source.

baseline.basis: Baseline to an evaluation that measured it as a comparator. The measured values belong to that evaluation's results, so this is not rb:evaluation.

model.basis: Evaluation to the configuration, model, method or pipeline actually evaluated. Not inherited by families.

baseline.basis: Baseline to the model or method that implements it. A baseline is not an evaluation, so this is not rb:evaluatedSubject.
Baseline to the configuration that implements it.

benchmark.basis: Evaluation to the task or protocol used.

dataset_subset.basis: Dataset subset to the protocol that uses it. A subset is not evaluated, so this is not rb:evaluatedOn.

family.basis: Configuration or variant to its model family. Results roll up only when a claim backs the link.

alias_of.basis: Same identity under another ID. Deliberately not owl:sameAs, which would merge results without review.

uses_model.basis: A pipeline or service depends on a model. Not transitive and not a subproperty of rb:evaluatedSubject: pipeline results are never results of the model.

part_of.basis: Component of a suite. A subproperty of dcterms:isPartOf and of the transitive rb:within, so the transitivity applies only to rewire part-of links.

evaluates_task.basis: Resource to the task it evaluates.

supersedes.basis: A newer record replacing an older one.

original_evaluation.basis: A copied result to the evaluation it was copied from.

subject.basis: Claim to the record it is about.

source.basis: Record to a source it is derived from.

applicable_to.basis: Candidate applicability; not evidence of performance.

same_data_as.basis: Informational data reuse; never merges results.

source_ids.basis: The source the record (a description) is taken from. prov:wasDerivedFrom would make every described thing, including evaluation runs, a prov:Entity derived from a paper.
